stem: How do the stranger's actions in paragraph 8 affect Kana's internal conflict?

options.label: A
options.text: His kindness in blocking the wind helps Kana overcome her mistrust of foreigners.

options.label: B
options.text: His rudeness in stepping in front of Kana confirms her opinion of foreigners.

options.label: C
options.text: His friendly gesture toward Kana causes her to feel even more nervous.

options.label: D
options.text: His disregard for Kana validates her beliefs about the superiority of her culture.
